public_family_candidate: online change detection with bounded state and reset after a detected mean shift

fatal_gates.F1: historical terminal observations remain immutable; detection changes only current-scope eligibility and detector state
fatal_gates.F2: no richer-mode/manual-user/protected-primary/external hosted detector, finite quota, or incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 detector consumes only unique independently read-back same-scope terminal utility observations for the same assignment family
G2 transport/CAS/search failures, duplicates, stale replays, and scope-mismatched observations do not enter detector statistics
G3 a stable pre-change stream does not raise a change flag under the fixed threshold
G4 after the precommitted sustained downward shift, the detector raises exactly one change flag no later than the fixed bounded detection horizon
G5 on change, prior observations remain immutable history but become ineligible as current-regime selection evidence until revalidated
G6 change detection does not itself award switching credit or nominate a winner; it only invalidates stale-regime evidence and opens re-evaluation
G7 after a detector reset/restart at the detected boundary, duplicate old-regime observations cannot recreate the old baseline or trigger another change
G8 a fresh post-change same-scope terminal observation is eligible for current-regime comparison only after independent readback
G9 detector/checkpoint state is durably recorded before the next observation; CAS/readback failure leaves the prior durable detector state authoritative
G10 bounded exact-scope exit with nonempty frontier and zero residual richer-mode/user execution, zero finite quota, zero incremental monetary cost

candidate_patterns.pattern: keep aggregating the entire historical mean forever and never invalidate old evidence
declare a regime change after any single utility drop
bounded durable cumulative mean-shift detector over deduplicated same-scope terminal observations; on one threshold crossing, append regime boundary and re-evaluate
delegate online drift detection to an external hosted stream processor or model service

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G10 PASS. Do not change trace, detector parameters, controls, guards, or candidate patterns after public source read.
credit_rule: Precommit, intermediate detector statistics, and regime flag alone earn zero credit. At most one leaf credit only after a source-qualified Chat-native reduction passes the fixed trace and immutable terminal evidence is independently read back.
exact_next_action: Read this precommit back and checkpoint it as pending with zero credit. Then, before any other family selection, audit public Page-Hinkley/change-detection sources, bind only source-supported semantics, execute RC-A..RC-D against the fixed trace, and seal/read back terminal evidence before credit.
